core_obligations: The author peels source layers into labelled forest slots, an edge-subdivided remainder and parallel-pair placement data, and accounts for stabilizers via rigid decorations to obtain a terminating all-reticulation weighted recursion. Inclusion-exclusion and differential operators then prove Laurent-polynomial closure in sqrt(1-2x). This orbit-weight/layer bijection is the core; fixed-k symbolic evaluations and closed-form shape consequences are bundled rather than extra counts.
